learnerTurns: My trip. I go to Kyoto yesterday.
assistantTurns: What would you like to talk about?
Kyoto sounds like a lovely trip. Say “I went to Kyoto yesterday.” What did you enjoy there?
They sound peaceful. Which garden was your favorite?
You described your Kyoto trip and said you loved the gardens. We practiced “I went to Kyoto yesterday,” using “went” for the past. Your sentence “I loved the gardens” was already natural.
Practice finished. Remember “went” when talking about yesterday. Thanks for sharing your Kyoto trip.

turns.content: What would you like to talk about?
My trip. I go to Kyoto yesterday.
Kyoto sounds like a lovely trip. Say “I went to Kyoto yesterday.” What did you enjoy there?

They sound peaceful. Which garden was your favorite?
Please review what we practiced.
You described your Kyoto trip and said you loved the gardens. We practiced “I went to Kyoto yesterday,” using “went” for the past. Your sentence “I loved the gardens” was already natural.
Finish the practice now.
Practice finished. Remember “went” when talking about yesterday. Thanks for sharing your Kyoto trip.

scenarios.criterion: Respond to meaning, correct one real error, and follow up without rewriting natural English. On request, review only completed practice and finish without a new question.
scenarios.rationale: The past-tense correction preserves yesterday; the natural second answer receives no rewrite.
